games.name: Honey Bee Idle

Bread to fancy cakes

Frog helpers
Hire frogs who tie bunches for you, even while you're away.

games.name: Pet Salon Idle

Puppies, kittens, bunnies and fox kits go from the Wash Tub to the Dryer and the Trim Table.

Helper bunnies
Bunnies bring pets to the stations by themselves, and nap when they're tired.

games.name: Sheep Merge
games.title: Sheep Merge: Cozy Wool Farm
games.tagline: Merge fluffy sheep and knit for a snowy village.
games.intro: The village is all snowed in and the villagers need warm things. Help Granny Purl grow sheep, gather their wool, knit cozy clothes and bring the village back to life.

Drag two of the same together: lambs grow all the way to the Golden Sheep.
Knit cozy things
Mittens, scarves, beanies, sweaters and quilts. Plus cocoa and cookies.
Friendly orders
A bunny, a fox, an owl and a hedgehog come by. No timers, nobody leaves angry.
Mend the village
Paint the barn, light the lanterns and put the star on the big tree.

games.name: Wool Tree Idle
games.title: Wool Tree Idle: Silk Tycoon
games.tagline: Grow silkworms, knit sweaters and build a winter wool farm.

Silkworms carry wool from the trees into jars. Walk over and collect it.
Craft & sell
Unlock the Spinning Wheel, the Loom and the Tailor Shop.
Rare silkworms
Blue, Golden, Ruby, Rainbow and the legendary Royal silkworm.
Earn while away
Your farm keeps working when the game is closed.

apps.name: Leafcure
apps.title: Leafcure: Plant Disease Doctor
apps.description: Leafcure is an AI plant doctor. Snap a sick leaf to identify the plant, find the disease or pest, and get step-by-step treatment.
apps.tagline: Your AI plant doctor. Snap a sick leaf to find the problem and get step-by-step treatment.
apps.lead: Snap a photo of a sick leaf. Leafcure names the plant, finds the disease or pest, and tells you what to do, step by step.
features: Find the problem
Identifies the plant and the most likely problem, with two other possibilities.
Know how serious it is
Shows how serious it is and how sure the diagnosis is.
Treat it safely
Gives treatment steps, safest options first, and tips to stop it coming back.
Pet safety check
Tells you if the plant is toxic to cats and dogs.
All in one place
Keeps your plants and past scans in one place.
Six languages
English, Deutsch, Français, Español, 日本語, Português.
steps: Take it in daylight, close to the sick part of the leaf.
See the plant, the likely problem and how sure Leafcure is.
Start with the safest treatment and stop it coming back.
faq: How do I get a good diagnosis?
Take the photo in daylight, close to the sick part of the leaf, and keep it sharp. If the photo is not clear enough, Leafcure tells you which photo to take next.
How many free scans do I get?
Two. Leafcure Premium unlocks unlimited scans and all features.
How do I cancel my subscription?

iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Leafcure → Cancel Subscription.
Android: Google Play → profile icon → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Leafcure → Cancel.
Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period to avoid the next charge. Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.
I bought Premium but the app still asks me to pay.
Open the paywall and tap Restore purchases, using the same Apple ID or Google account you paid with. If that does not help, email us.
How do I get a refund?
Payments are handled by Apple and Google, so refunds are too. iPhone: reportaproblem.apple.com. Android: Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history, or the Google Play Help Center.
Is the diagnosis always right?
No. Leafcure gives AI advice and can be wrong. Always read the product label before using any treatment, and ask a local garden center when a plant is valuable or the problem is spreading fast.
What happens to my photos?
Photos are sent securely to create the diagnosis and are not stored on our server. Your history stays on your phone. See the Privacy Policy.
How do I delete my data?
Delete a scan from History, or delete the app to remove everything. We do not keep an account for you.

apps.name: Paincast
apps.title: Paincast: Barometric Pressure Alerts & Pain Diary
apps.description: Paincast warns you 24–48 hours before big air pressure changes and keeps a simple pain diary, so you can plan around the weather.
apps.tagline: Air pressure alerts 24–48 hours ahead, with a simple pain diary that stays on your phone.
apps.lead: Paincast watches the air pressure where you live and tells you 24–48 hours before a big change, so you can plan your day.
features: Today at a glance
Calm, changing or a big change ahead.
9-day forecast
A 9-day air pressure forecast with the big changes marked.
Early alerts
Alerts before big pressure drops and rises, plus a morning summary.
One-tap pain diary
For headaches, migraine, joint pain and more.
Your own pattern
See how your entries line up with pressure changes.
Six languages
English, Deutsch, Français, Español, 日本語, Português.
steps: Paincast watches the air pressure where you live.
Hear about a big change 24–48 hours ahead.
Log how you feel in one tap and see your own pattern.
faq: Is Paincast medical advice?
No. Paincast shows weather forecasts and compares them with your own diary. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. If your pain is new, severe or getting worse, see a doctor.
Where does the weather data come from?
From MET Norway (the Norwegian Meteorological Institute), under the CC BY 4.0 licence. It covers the whole world.
Why didn't I get an alert?

Check that notifications are allowed for Paincast in your phone's settings and that alerts are on in Paincast → Settings. Alerts are planned from the latest forecast, so open the app now and then to keep them up to date.
What is free and what is Premium?
Free: today's status, the next 48 hours, the diary and a morning summary. Premium adds the 9-day forecast, early alerts, your full pattern, several places and diary export.
How do I cancel my subscription?

iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Paincast → Cancel Subscription.
Android: Google Play → profile icon → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → Paincast → Cancel.
Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period to avoid the next charge. Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.
I bought Premium but the app still asks me to pay.
Open Settings and tap Restore purchases, using the same Apple ID or Google account you paid with. If that does not help, email us.
How do I get a refund?
Payments are handled by Apple and Google, so refunds are too. iPhone: reportaproblem.apple.com. Android: Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Budget & history, or the Google Play Help Center.
How do I delete my data?
Paincast → Settings → Delete all my data, or delete the app. Your diary is only on your phone; we have no account for you.
